verdict.rationale: Porkbun publishes its own API documentation and mirrors every real endpoint under `/mock`. That lets a user call any endpoint with zero setup (no key, no account) and see its exact response shape, which serves as a runnable, explorable reference. There is no evidence of an interactive in-browser console or embedded runnable examples, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec for tooling to render. missing for 10: an interactive try-it API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Learn any endpoint's exact response shape with **zero setup** — no key, no account. Every real path is mirrored under `/mock`
